The structure of MgSn₃ crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing eight atoms (Mg₂Sn₆) distributed over two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for both Mg and Sn centers, each with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom, with Mg surrounded by 12 Sn neighbors and Sn by 4 Mg and 8 Sn neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all eight sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations show Sn–Sn 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, while Mg–Sn polyhedra share edges.
